problems: services.postgres.version: Stagd runs Postgres 16, 17, 18 and 19, not "15"

services.postgres.seed should be an https URL of a pg_dump, e.g. seed: "https://seeds.example.com/app.dump?${SEED_TOKEN}"
services.postgres: unknown setting "size"; it takes version, database and seed
